findings.claim: Validated exact private local identity configuration opts into original authentication POST only while default readonly business boundaries remain closed.
findings.evidence: public-code-material-0.txt: load_management_oidc_config 严格验证私钥配置（权限0700/0600、字段完整性、大小限制）；management_app 以 allow_password_login=bool(config) 启用 ReadOnlyManagementApp，仅允许 POST /v1/auth/token，其余方法返回 405；environment 设置 AOS_AUTH_ALLOW_DEV=1、AOS_AUTH_EXTERNAL_ONLY=0；material-4.txt 报告 defaultReadonlyPreserved=true、businessMutationsAllowed=false

findings.claim: Web password credentials and refresh tokens are not persisted or queued; access token is published only after original canonical me succeeds.
findings.evidence: public-code-material-2.txt: loginPassword 先 clearAccessToken，仅存储 access_token（内存），localStorage/SessionStorage 均无写入；fetch 调用 /v1/me 成功后才 setAccessToken；test: expect(localStorage.getItem("access_token")).toBeNull(); expect(sessionStorage.getItem("refresh_token")).toBeNull()

findings.claim: Server login policy prevents unauthenticated external-only users mounting business catalog consumers and preserves explicitly enabled legacy development UI.
findings.evidence: public-code-material-1.txt: LocalLoginGate 读取 /v1/auth/oidc 策略，allowDevToken=true 直接渲染 children（legacy），否则显示登录表单并阻塞 children；app-integration.txt: App 组件中 LocalLoginGate 包裹 RuntimeWorkshopCatalogProvider 等所有业务 catalog；material-3.txt 测试：allowDevToken=true 时包含 "business catalog"，allowDevToken=false 时不包含

findings.claim: Reported tests and enrollment are bounded code and metadata evidence; live login and eight workbench acceptance remain unproven.
findings.evidence: material-4.txt: liveApiIntegrated=false, eightWorkshopsAccepted=false；material-5.txt: liveApiOrWebReloaded=false, eightPagesAccepted=false；material-6.txt: businessRuntimeOpened=false, liveLoginAccepted=false；scope-clarification.txt 明确声明 review 不 claim 浏览器登录或八个 workbench 验收

result.next_safe_step: 保留当前冻结状态；如需推进，需在真实 OIDC 环境、实际浏览器会话下完成一次完整 password login + /v1/me 链路验证，并逐一访问八个工作bench页面确认可加载。
